topic: 环境话题与学术阅读定位
grammarFocus: 被动语态；因果表达；分词作定语的基础辨认。
title: Campus Recycling and Academic Reading Strategies
instructions: 本材料为模拟教学练习，非官方雅思考试。听力部分包含一段关于校园回收项目的对话和一段关于学术阅读定位的讲解。请先听录音（或阅读转录文本），然后完成10道题目。题目类型包括单选、填空、匹配（通过单选实现）和判断正误/未提及。填空题答案必须来自原文，且不超过字数限制。所有解析为中文，证据为英文原文引用。
transcript:
Mia: Hi, Ben. You look busy. What are you working on?
Ben: Oh, hi Mia. I’m preparing a report for my environmental science class. It’s about the campus recycling program. But I’m a bit confused about the data.
Mia: Really? What’s the problem?
Ben: Well, the recycling bins were placed in all buildings last year, but the amount of recycled paper hasn’t increased much. I thought it would go up.
Mia: Hmm, maybe people are not using them correctly. I saw a sign saying that plastic bags are not allowed in the paper bins.
Ben: Right, but that sign was put up only last month. Before that, many people threw plastic bags into the paper bins by mistake.
Mia: So the contamination was caused by the lack of clear instructions?
Ben: Exactly. The recycling company said that contaminated paper cannot be processed, so it’s sent to the landfill. That’s why the recycling rate is low.
Mia: That makes sense. So what are you going to do?
Ben: I’m going to recommend more workshops for students. Also, I’m reading some articles about recycling behavior. But I find academic articles difficult to read.
Mia: Me too. I learned a strategy called “reading for gist” – you read the title, abstract, and conclusion first to get the main idea, then you look for specific details.
Ben: That sounds helpful. So I don’t need to read every word?
Mia: No, especially for long articles. You can also look for signal words like “because”, “therefore”, “as a result” to understand causes and effects.
Ben: Good tip. I’ll try that. Thanks, Mia!
Mia: You’re welcome. Good luck with your report!

grammar.title: 被动语态与因果表达
grammar.explanation: 被动语态表示主语是动作的承受者，结构为be+过去分词。因果表达常用because, so, therefore, as a result等词。分词作定语时，现在分词表示主动，过去分词表示被动。
grammar.example: The recycling bins were placed in all buildings last year.

questions.prompt: Choose the correct passive form: The report ________ by Ben yesterday.
questions.explanation: 报告是被写的，且时间是昨天，用一般过去时的被动语态。
questions.evidence: The report was written by Ben yesterday.

questions.prompt: Identify the participle used as an adjective: The ________ paper is sent to the landfill.
questions.explanation: 过去分词contaminated作定语，表示“被污染的”。

options: The bins were placed last year.
The bins are place last year.
answers: The bins were placed last year.
questions.explanation: 被动语态需要be动词加过去分词。
questions.evidence: The bins were placed last year.
